description:
A GPU-accelerated terminal for Windows that keeps your sessions alive.

Nebula is a terminal emulator for Windows, built in Rust on a GPU-accelerated rendering core and designed around one idea: your terminal sessions are too valuable to die with a window. It pairs a tmux-style resident session model with a glass UI, an AI-CLI-aware sidebar, and a shell experience that works without extra setup.
macOS, Linux, and Android downloads are Preview builds.
Added
- Add streaming SFTP previews for remote UTF-8 files.
- Add SFTP editing and conflict checks for UTF-8 files up to 8 MiB.
- Add progressive image previews with progress, cancel, and retry.
- Add Luau configuration and plugin commands, with legacy filenames still recognized.
- Add font, opacity, tab, and pane defaults in pebrel.luau.
- Add GLSL background and terminal effects alongside WGSL.
- Add shader controls for animation speed, frame rate, and parameters.
- Add opt-in next-message suggestions for supported local Claude Code, Pi, and OpenCode sessions.
- Add a separate provider and model for next-message suggestions.
- Add Tab to fill a suggested message without sending it.
- Add the prediction model name while Pi or OpenCode waits for a suggestion.
- Add native click-to-place and drag selection in supported Bash, Zsh, and PowerShell input.
- Add directly transmitted, uncompressed RGB/RGBA images via the Kitty graphics protocol. (#767)
- Add SFTP Name and Size columns, a full-height file list, and a status bar.
- Add copy and download actions on SFTP file rows.
- Add file and folder uploads plus remote copy and paste in SFTP.
- Add Ctrl/Shift selection and batch downloads in SFTP.
- Add drag-out downloads from the SFTP list.
- Add Japanese translations for settings help and option labels. (#793)
Fixed
- Fix SFTP preview opening for PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, and GIF first frames. Addresses #861.
- Fix Codex permission requests showing a busy spinner.
- Fix misaligned activity icons in the sidebar and top tabs.
- Fix explicit agent states being overwritten when full Hooks are available.
- Fix generic notifications incorrectly showing the input-request indicator.
- Fix OpenCode permission and question replies, and busy and retry indicators.
- Fix OpenCode idle events being mistaken for success.
- Fix agent Hook routing after reattaching supported SSH sessions.
- Fix SSH task titles falling out of sync with the active pane after reattaching.
- Fix duplicate CLI spinners and progress symbols in AI task titles.
- Fix native pointer editing with remapped PSReadLine chords in Windows PowerShell.
- Fix duplicate tabs when the running process receives a launch but its reply is lost. Addresses #797.
- Fix localhost proxying with an empty bypass list, including OpenCode startup. Addresses #807.
- Fix a stale cursor crash during terminal resize or selection. Addresses #788.
- Fix the welcome command in fish with or without Fastfetch. Addresses #803.
- Fix workspace shortcuts while an image tab has focus. Addresses #774.
- Fix search for Japanese settings and localized shortcut actions. Addresses #821.
- Fix nested paths being cut off after native Tab completion. Addresses #676.
- Fix workspace and agent session restoration after Windows shutdown. Addresses #792.
- Fix MSYS2 Zsh discovery and shell detection for imported executables. Addresses #812.
- Fix false busy indicators for ordinary full-screen terminal tools. Addresses #805.
- Fix immediate disconnects on Windows SSH hosts that cannot run POSIX startup integration. Addresses #810.
- Fix Shift+Enter so it inserts a newline in recognized CodeBuddy sessions. Addresses #839.
- Fix shell and profile ID instructions in CLI help, completions, and docs. Addresses #665.
- Fix unbounded X11 input method property names in long Linux sessions. (#668)
- Fix missing Hermes artwork and incorrect agent icon colors. (#832)
- Fix cramped hover spacing on the Project and Support entries. Addresses #859.
- Fix small click targets for the Clear and Restore keymap buttons. (#644)
